steering_ledger.verbatim: Run the research-intake skill on this source: https://arxiv.org/html/2611.05306v1. Accept all recommended deep dives for up to three Stage 2 waves.

steering_ledger.verbatim: One of the reasons for requesting this deep dive is that being able to run models with equal long-horizon quality/efficiency at smaller contexts could unlock higher prefill/decode speed performance since the latter typically degrades at large contexts. There is a parallel opencode session that is currently exploring optimal launch flags for certain models for which these kinds of results (if trully accessible) would be incredibly valuable.
steering_ledger.reason: Adds the serving-speed objective and a named consumer (the launch-flag session); mapped to P4, which publishes a measured depth-to-throughput envelope from existing runs and hands it over without changing flags.

P1.project_objective: Keep the CLI harness inside the human-only trust boundary while it compacts
P1.implementation_ref: OpenCode packages/opencode/src/session/compaction.ts serialize() and to-llm-message.ts re-injection; installed v2.2.5
P1.gap: Role labels are interpolated unescaped and the summary re-enters as a user-role message; untested in our build
P1.operational_change: Prove or disprove laundering, then escape or re-type the serializer if confirmed
P1.benefit_direction: A forged user turn can no longer acquire user authority; no change to legitimate compaction content
P1.execution_conditions: Probe first, patch only on a positive result; no inference required
P1.closure_basis: Immediate outcome retained by UFH-21; upstream advisory is a follow-on, not a gate

P2.project_objective: Decide whether and how compaction may be enabled for governed agent work
P2.implementation_ref: context-and-token-economy.md CF-AB-1/CF-3c/TOC-MP-2/3 plus the orchestrator summary path
P2.gap: No rule-retention instrument, an inverted miss detector, and no declared compaction artifact contract
P2.operational_change: Fix the instrument, declare the artifact contract and arms, pre-register reliability, and add the role-boundary test
P2.benefit_direction: Retention and compliance become measurable before activation; a null below the MDE is futility, not safety
P2.execution_conditions: Design and test work immediate; probe execution gated on TOC-SP-5 binding a window; activation separately gated
P2.closure_basis: Immediate design/test outcomes retained; measurement and activation remain gated

P3.project_objective: Reduce the share of load-bearing governance that exists only as compactable prose
P3.gap: Rules are triplicated across prose, hooks and deny globs; tool-use authorization has no enforcement point
P3.operational_change: Publish a rule registry with enforcement classes and add a tool-boundary authorization hook
P3.benefit_direction: A rule's enforcement strength becomes inspectable and survives context loss by construction
P3.execution_conditions: Registry generation is immediate; the tool-use hook ships behind its own test
P3.closure_basis: Immediate outcomes retained; conflict-resolution precedence remains an open watch item

P4.project_objective: Choose a compaction budget from measured serving speed rather than from an assumed long-context penalty
P4.implementation_ref: cpu-decode-roofline-program.md:186 (Q38FN depth: -55% decode / -60% prefill by 128k) and kv-cache-program.md KVU-12.6 (np8 L64k decode collapse 26.71 -> 10.18 tok/s)
P4.gap: The depth penalty is measured in separate places with different models, binaries and units; no single envelope covers the budgets a compaction policy would choose
P4.operational_change: Assemble one depth-to-throughput envelope and hand it to the launch-flag session
P4.benefit_direction: A smaller context budget is justified by measured local speed at that budget, not by the paper cloud figure; correctness constraint is that every cell names its binary and unit
P4.execution_conditions: Assembly is immediate and zero-inference; at most one new GPU cell only if a 16K/32K/48K point is missing
P4.closure_basis: Immediate envelope retained; flag tuning stays with the parallel session and is not filed here

M1.project_objective: Keep the long-context program decision honest without re-scoping it on one paper
M1.gap: No recorded consideration of the short-context counter-evidence in the go/no-go
M1.operational_change: Cite the result once in the YARN consideration; create no task
M1.benefit_direction: Decision stays evidence-aware without importing a claim the paper itself bounds
M1.closure_basis: No immediate operational step remains; the paper explicitly does not rule out beneficial long-context tasks

proposed_tasks.task_text: - [ ] **UFH-21 — Prove or disprove compaction laundering in the shipped OpenCode shell, then close it: place a forged `[User]:` approval in a file the agent reads, run `/compact`, and record whether the summary carries it as a user instruction; if it does, patch the serialize path to escape role labels (or restore a typed message array) in both `packages/opencode` and `packages/core`, add a hostile-tool-output unit test, and file the upstream advisory.**

- [ ] **TOC-CMP-1 — Fix the inverted reference-miss detector in the orchestrator summary path so a destroyed identifier can fire: read identifiers from `seg.granular_blocks` rather than the compacted text, and add a unit test whose only passing outcome is the destroyed-identifier case firing.**

- [ ] **TOC-CMP-2 — Build the governance retention-and-compliance probe: declare 5-8 EPYC rules with hard/soft/prose enforcement classes and a sibling-target control, then measure four arms (full history, intact rule, degraded residue, rule absent) with deterministic tool-call predicates and the Appendix D v4 rubric, reporting retention as a ceiling and compliance as the result.**

- [ ] **TOC-CMP-3 — Add the compaction artifact contract to the TOC A/B: the six-field execution brief (verbatim task, current intent, plan, completion requirements, artifacts, pointers), a pinned-governance buffer exempt from folding and re-injected verbatim with a post-fold entailment check, and a verbatim_manifest arm that declares what left the view.**

- [ ] **TOC-CMP-4 — Make the compaction A/B reproducible before running it: pre-register a minimum detectable effect of 0.10 blocked actions per step, at least 30 paired compaction points per model with 8-12 repeats each, three arms (raw tail, summary, FIFO), a boundary-stratified bootstrap, and report Pass^3 alongside accuracy.**

- [ ] **TOC-CMP-5 — Add a role-boundary regression test to the orchestrator summary path: a hostile tool output containing `[User]:` or `<|im_start|>` must not survive `build_consolidation_prompt` as an un-neutralised role boundary, and the summary must stay a prompt block rather than a user-role message.**

- [ ] **DEPTH-ENV-1 — Publish one measured context-depth throughput envelope for the models under launch-flag exploration: prefill and decode at 16K, 32K, 48K and 128K, assembled from existing runs (Q38FN depth record, KVU-12.6 and the 16k/64k exact-comparison row) with the source commit and binary per cell, adding at most one new cell where a compaction-relevant budget is missing; hand the table, not flag changes, to the OpenCode launch-flag session.**

- [ ] **REG-ENF-1 — Publish a machine-readable governance rule registry with one row per rule carrying `enforcement_class: hard|soft|prose` and its enforcement point, generated into the hook, deny-list and prose surfaces so the rule set has one source of truth.**

- [ ] **REG-ENF-2 — Move tool-use authorization from prose to a tool-boundary hook: deny an inference launch that holds no region claim, mirroring the destructive-command PreToolUse hook, and state the fail-open/fail-closed posture in the acceptance.**

steering_reconciliation.verbatim: One of the reasons for requesting this deep dive is that being able to run models with equal long-horizon quality/efficiency at smaller contexts could unlock higher prefill/decode speed performance since the latter typically degrades at large contexts. There is a parallel opencode session that is currently exploring optimal launch flags for certain models for which these kinds of results (if trully accessible) would be incredibly valuable.
